title: NavigationAgent2D changes target_position
body: ### Tested versions Godot 4.4.1-stable ### System information Macbook Pro Apple M3 Pro - macos sequoia 15.4.1 ### Issue description I have a test scene with multiple navigation agents : I use a state machine to make the animals wander, and one of them (StaticAnimalBase8) must reach a target position The first seconds of this reach state work fine, but then randomly, target_position changes: ReachTargetState extends State signal target_reached # TODO add check that it's not ZERO or target is reachable @export var target_position: Vector2 func _ready() -> void: set_physics_process(false) func enter_state(_state_parameter: Variant = null) -> void: set_physics_process(true) if not velocity_component.direction_changed.is_connected(_on_direction_changed): var __: int = velocity_component.direction_changed.connect(_on_direction_changed) if not navigation_agent.target_reached.is_connected(_on_target_reached): var __: int = navigation_agent.target_reached.connect(_on_target_reached) #if not navigation_agent.path_changed.is_connected(_on_path_changed): #var __: int = navigation_agent.path_changed.connect(_on_path_changed) navigation_agent.target_position = target_position # TODO check if destination is reachable, if not, emit a signal print("actor %s enter_state navigation_agent.target_position = %s" % [actor.name, target_position]) func exit_state() -> void: if velocity_component.direction_changed.is_connected(_on_direction_changed): velocity_component.direction_changed.disconnect(_on_direction_changed) if navigation_agent.target_reached.is_connected(_on_target_reached): navigation_agent.target_reached.disconnect(_on_target_reached) set_physics_process(false) func avoid_obstacle(_collision_position: Vector2) -> void: pass func physics_process(delta: float) -> void: if NavigationServer2D.map_get_iteration_id(navigation_agent.get_navigation_map()) == 0: Debug.log_debug("Map empty", Debug.ComponentNames.STATE_REACH) return print( ( "actor %s physics_process navigation_agent.target_position = %s global_position = %s" % [actor.name, navigation_agent.target_position, actor.global_position] ) ) var navigation_next_position: Vector2 = navigation_agent.get_next_path_position() # If target is not reachable if ( not navigation_agent.is_target_reachable() or navigation_agent.target_position != navigation_agent.get_final_position() ): Debug.log_debug( ( "Actor %s target_position %s is not reachable - switch to final_position %s" % [actor.name, target_position, navigation_agent.get_final_position()] ), Debug.ComponentNames.STATE_REACH ) navigation_agent.target_position = navigation_agent.get_final_position() if navigation_agent.is_navigation_finished(): Debug.log_debug("Actor %s navigation is finished" % actor.name, Debug.ComponentNames.STATE_REACH) target_reached.emit() return velocity_component.accelerate_to_destination( navigation_next_position + navigation_agent.get_parent().position * -1, delta ) var __: Vector2 = velocity_component.move(actor) #region Signals func _on_target_reached() -> void: print( ( "actor %s target reached navigation_agent.target_position=%s" % [actor.name, navigation_agent.target_position] ) ) print("actor %s target reached actor.global_position=%s" % [actor.name, actor.global_position]) target_reached.emit() #func _on_path_changed() -> void: #print("path changed for actor %s" % actor.name) func _on_direction_changed(new_direction: Vector2) -> void: # if actor is Player, run animation_player from player first which will call visual_move_component if actor is Player: actor.set_animation("Walk", new_direction) else: visual_move_component.set_animation_for_direction(new_direction, "Walk") #endregion ``` I use the same state class for other actors in the same scene (the pink gnome at top left and the player at bottom left) and I don't have the problem for those entities (they use the same navigation layer, but are on different avoidance layer) StaticAnimalBase8 if the black mow at top left, it should target bottom right like the gnome pink Video: https://streamable.com/q6lmge ### Steps to reproduce Cannot explain ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Cannot
